metas.name: 1. Bart's Birthday
metas.description: Bart celebrates the most shocking birthday party of his entire life — one that might just change everyone in Springfield forever.

metas.name: 2. The Yellow Lotus
metas.description: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

metas.name: 3. Desperately Seeking Lisa
metas.description: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

metas.name: 4. Shoddy Heat
metas.description: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s… as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

metas.name: 5. Treehouse of Horror XXXV
metas.description: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be ca

metas.name: 6. Women in Shorts
metas.description: Girls just want to have funny.

metas.name: 7. Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
metas.description: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

metas.name: 8. Convenience Airways
metas.description: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

metas.name: 9. Homer and Her Sisters
metas.description: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

metas.name: 10. The Man Who Flew Too Much
metas.description: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

metas.name: 11. Bottle Episode
metas.description: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

metas.name: 12. The Flandshees of Innersimpson
metas.description: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

metas.name: 13. The Last Man Expanding
metas.description: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

metas.name: 14. P.S. I Hate You
metas.description: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

metas.name: 15. Abe League of Their Moe
metas.description: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

metas.name: 16. Stew Lies
metas.description: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food... with some help from the mob.

metas.name: 17. Full Heart, Empty Pool
metas.description: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off the team.

metas.name: 18. Estranger Things
metas.description: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!
